title: Tape-specific machine action
statement: For one of the three work tapes $t$, an input-head movement, an optional write instruction, an output symbol, and a successor state, define an action that applies the supplied write instruction and movement to tape $t$, leaves the other two work tapes unwritten and stationary, and records the specified input-head movement, output symbol, and successor state.
